subject.title: refactor(macos): move PortGuardian state to SQLite

question: Should OpenClaw accept the one-way PortGuardian JSON-to-SQLite cutover and fail closed when an older JSON-writing macOS copy shares the state directory?
rationale: This is an intentional upgrade and code-signing boundary, not a mechanical correctness question; it can change recovery and rollback behavior for existing macOS installations.

options.title: Accept the one-way cutover
options.body: Merge after the prerequisite and final-head proof confirm the documented mixed-version exclusion and recovery behavior.

options.title: Require a different upgrade contract
options.body: Pause the stack and define a supported downgrade or coordinated-upgrade path before accepting the storage migration.

recommendation.title: Accept the one-way cutover
recommendation.body: Merge after the prerequisite and final-head proof confirm the documented mixed-version exclusion and recovery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current proposed migration design and can provide the requested native proof and contract clarification.
